To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the impacts and adaptation of climate change can affect mitigation and that the effects of mitigation on impacts and adaptation can be important.
climate change can result in an increase of cropland and a decrease of bioenergy production, and these two effects, in turn, result in a reduction of mitigation.
climate change can increase the cost of mitigation by increasing agricultural land demand and decreasing bioenergy supply.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how the impacts of climate change affect the cost of mitigating emissions.
the interactions between mitigation and adaptation and the implications of these interactions for future emissions.
the question: what are the implications of simultaneously considering mitigation and impacts/adaption?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cost of mitigation is sensitive to climate change, impacts, and adaptive responses.
mitigation and adaptation are both necessary to reduce the costs of climate change.
climate change impacts and adaptation can affect the costs of mitigation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mitigation and adaptation are interdependent, and thus should be considered simultaneously in integrated assessment modeling.
mitigation and adaptation are interrelated and that impacts and adaptation can affect mitigation.

climate change impacts and adaptation can increase the cost of mitigation, but the extent to which this occurs depends on the details of the mitigation, impacts, adaptation, and feedbacks between these components.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is important to consider interactions between mitigation, impacts, adaption, and other sectors when developing policy.
the impacts and adaptation decisions that we make in the near future can have significant implications for the cost of mitigation in the future.
the interactions between mitigation, impacts, adaption, and other factors are important, and that the impacts of climate change are not just an additional factor in the future.
